structure.unit: Venue, Jurisdiction and Procedure in Civil Matters

law.catch_line: Limitations on enforcement of district court judgments
law.text: For judgments entered in a general district court on or after January 1, 1985, no execution shall be issued or action brought on such judgment, including a judgment in favor of the Commonwealth, after ten years from the date of such judgment except as provided in § 16.1-69.55 B 4.
